Open to work

01 Bio

Open to internships and part-time roles

I'm an integrated Master's student in Data Science at the Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU), specialising in Business Analytics, and I'm looking for internships and part-time roles in data analytics, business intelligence and applied machine learning. My work sits between complex datasets and strategic decisions: machine learning and deep learning, numerical simulation, data engineering pipelines and operations research. I care about models that can be explained, validated and acted on. Beyond the code, I bring leadership from chairing student and youth organisations, local-government experience as a deputy district council member, and the communication skills of a teaching assistant.
